title: Asahina Mafuyu — A Period Of Warmth〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Stopped Hand Moves Once More

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The stew Ms. Mochizuki makes has such a gentle flavor to it. I can't seem to get enough of it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, these bamboo shoots also have a nice texture to them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your dad should be arriving soon, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
My mind is already made up.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm going to see if I can talk to my mom.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I was just asking if you could hand me a napkin. I accidentally spilled some of my stew...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Were you thinking about this weekend?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
It's been a while, so it's no wonder you're nervous.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know. I'll make us some tea.
That should help you relax a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you like me to help?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I've gotten used to making it on my own.
Please feel free to keep eating, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think I asked you this before, but the room I'm using was your mom's, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can I ask you more about her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She was nice, but also strong-willed... At least, that's what I remember.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Whenever I acted naughty, she scolded me. And whenever I helped her with the housework, she praised me and patted my head.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Haha...
I was a little rambunctious when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What do you think? I feel like I've gotten a lot better at this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, you have. In the beginning, you used to spill the water and tea leaves often, but you haven't recently.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ever since you began staying here, Mafuyu, I've had more opportunities to practice, I guess. Oh, it's very hot, so please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You can lean on me anytime.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because I sort of understand what it means to feel anxious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If there's anything you want to ask me about, that's totally fine... And I'll also do my best to come up with good topics on my own.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ena and Mizuki will also probably jump onto Nightcord if you ask them. Plus, you can always go to see Miku and the others in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, please don't hesitate to ask.
